channel.title: Rippling IT Product Launches
channel.description: Latest product launches for IT admins (scope: it)

item.title: RPass Admin Overview Enhancements
item.description: RPass admin overview has been revamped to consolidate user-level insights on a single page. • Clearly differentiates user states (not in rules vs. never used vs. previously used) • Surfaces every item a user has access to and at what permission level • Highlights at-risk and out-of-compliance logins directly in the overview

item.title: RPass Admin Vault Management Enhancements
item.description: RPass admin vault management has been enhanced with item-level visibility and direct controls. • Item-level view replaces the legacy domain-grouped view • View and manage folders and sharing permissions directly from the admin • Add items, search, and filter by tags, password strength, and compliance status inline

item.title: Step Up Auth Copy Updates
item.description: Step Up authentication prompts now include clearer copy explaining why re-authentication is required. • Updated messaging conveys that the action is guarded and Step Up must be completed to proceed • Reduces confusion and support tickets around unexpected re-auth prompts

item.title: Default integration attributes permissions fix
item.description: Permission scope for setting default integration attributes has been expanded. • All app admins can now update the default integration attribute (previously super-admin only) • Removes the need to escalate to super admins for routine integration setup

item.title: 3P group push and pull reliability
item.description: Third-party group push and pull reliability has been improved. • Updated sync mechanism reduces failures for connected-app group memberships • More dependable propagation of group changes across third-party integrations

item.title: Store checkout page redesign
item.description: The Devices Store checkout page has been redesigned for a faster, more flexible ordering flow. • Simplified, easier-to-use checkout experience • More flexible configuration options at purchase time

item.title: New Logistic Flows
item.description: Redesigned logistic flows now: • Allows user to view and edit all the actions to be taken in a single screen • Allows scheduling shipping and unassignment in the future • Allows creating a shipping label only instead of always sending a box

item.title: Risk register
item.description: Automated Compliance now includes a built-in risk register, replacing the manual spreadsheet workflow. • Survey-driven review of each risk, capturing inherent risk, mapped mitigating controls, and residual risk • Direct mapping between risks and the controls that address them • Generates the risk register evidence required for a SOC 2 audit

item.title: Zendesk OAuth Migration
item.description: Zendesk integration now uses modern OAuth. • Existing Zendesk connections move to OAuth-based authentication • Replaces legacy auth for more reliable connection management

item.title: Multi-region - Top 5 Apps
item.description: EU data residency is now supported for the top 5 SaaS app integrations. • Microsoft 365, Slack, and Zoom certified and enabled for EU customers

item.title: Advanced Offboarding for Microsoft 365
item.description: Advanced offboarding for Microsoft 365 is now live. • Expanded offboarding actions for Microsoft 365 accounts • Parity with Rippling's enhanced Google Workspace offboarding flow

item.title: Devices Store relaunch
item.description: Devices Store has been relaunched. • Refreshed Devices Store experience for browsing and ordering • Foundation for upcoming device catalog improvements

item.title: RPass sharing and folder management
item.description: Password Manager now supports sharing and folder management. • Share credentials with structured sharing grants • Organize credentials with folders

item.title: Work email policies
item.description: Work email policies are now supported. • Define policies that govern how work emails are assigned and updated for employees

item.title: (Integration) Access Assignments
item.description: Access assignments for integrations are now available. • Assign app access via the integration manager

item.title: 3 new S1 SKUs (Purple AI, Cloud Funnel, Vigilance MDR)
item.description: Three new SentinelOne SKUs are now available. • Purple AI, Cloud Funnel, and Vigilance MDR purchasable as part of the SentinelOne offering through Rippling

item.title: Google inbound SSO setup flow
item.description: Google inbound SSO setup now supports direct metadata XML upload. • Upload Google metadata XML directly, no separate hosting required • Streamlined setup for Google as your IdP • Available with the new third-party IdP connector SKU

item.title: Inbound SSO from JumpCloud
item.description: Inbound SSO from JumpCloud is now supported. • Use JumpCloud as your IdP to sign in • SAML-based setup

item.title: Google Workspace (Inbound SSO) federated authentication
item.description: Inbound SSO from Google Workspace via federated authentication is now supported. • Use Google Workspace as your IdP to sign in

item.title: Inbound SSO from OneLogin
item.description: Inbound SSO from OneLogin is now supported. • Use OneLogin as your IdP to sign in • SAML-based setup

item.title: Remote Access (Mac)
item.description: Remote access for Mac devices is now available. • Remote into managed Mac devices from the admin console • Self-serve purchase available

item.title: Scoped SSO (Outbound)
item.description: Outbound SSO can now be rolled out in a scoped manner for third-party app integrations. • Roll out SSO to specific users or groups before full deployment • Exclude users or groups after a full rollout

item.title: Access exclusions in hiring/transition
item.description: Access exclusions in hiring and transition flows are now available. • Exclude specific end users from access policies they would otherwise be part of

item.title: Smooth Migration (Windows Entra)
item.description: Smooth migration is now available for Entra-joined Windows devices. • Migrate devices while keeping them connected to Entra • Path to converting Entra accounts to local accounts after migration

item.title: RPass admin revamp
item.description: Password Manager admin experience has been revamped. • Refreshed admin views for managing credentials

item.title: Mac migration for supervised devices
item.description: Mac migration now preserves supervised status during the move. • Migrate supervised Mac devices without losing supervision

item.title: Push Work Email updates to 3P Apps
item.description: Work email updates now push to connected third-party apps. • Initial coverage: Slack, Zoom, Atlassian, Salesforce, Gong, Google • Reduces stale email addresses across the SaaS stack after employee changes

item.title: Remote Access (Windows)
item.description: Remote access for Windows devices is now available. • Remote into managed Windows devices from the admin console • Complements the Mac remote access capability

item.title: Attribute mapping v2
item.description: Attribute mapping v2 is now live for third-party app integrations. • Per-user preview of what will be pushed to a connected app • Side-by-side comparison of internal values vs the third-party app's current values • Mismatch detection, single-user push, and improved activity logs

item.title: Google Workspace Offboarding v2
item.description:
Advanced policy management • Create, update, duplicate, archive, and reorder offboarding policies by priority Safer policy iteration with full version history and restore capabilities
Simulation & admin confidence • Simulate mode to preview user-level offboarding actions before execution Helps admins validate policies and build trust before enabling automation
Comprehensive visibility & audit tracking • Offboarding Activity records with user-level and action-level status tracking • Clear error messages with manual retry controls for failed actions • Policy changelog tracking who changed what and when

item.title: SSO Improvements (BDR, error msg)
item.description:
When configuring a BDR policy where Action = Block sign-in (for all apps or specific apps), admins can now:
• Add a custom message per policy • Use a rich text editor (formatting + hyperlinks supported) • Include links to resources (e.g., security training in LMS) • Preview the message before saving • Override the default fallback message (fully backward compatible)
This works for both: • Editing existing BDR policies • Creating new BDR policies
Users who are blocked will now see the configured message during SSO instead of a generic error.

item.title: SSO Latency Improvements
item.description: Rearchitected network requests resulting in a 50% reduction in median latency

item.title: Bulk 3P Group Push Bug Fix
item.description: Bug fix • Fixed an issue where landing groups in a stuck state

item.title: Improved Software Experience
item.description:
Improved software deployment management • Easily view the status of software deployments across your organization • Quickly identify errors and issues with detailed explanations • Explore and manage software from an improved catalog experience
Better debugging and policy deployment visibility • Detailed error tracking for policy deployments • Clear insights into deployment failures to help admins quickly diagnose and resolve issues

item.title: Standalone Inventory Management
item.description: Device lifecycle management improvements • Fully decoupled solution for managing device workflows end-to-end • Supports shipping devices to and from the warehouse • Enables device inspection and buyback processes • Operates independently without requiring MDM integration

item.title: API latency improvements
item.description:
API performance improvements • Improved latency across APIs impacting critical user workflows • Enhancements apply to SSO login, individual and group assignments, SCIM/SAML setup, and offboarding
Faster identity and provisioning workflows • Achieved ~20–25% average latency reduction across affected endpoints • Delivered 50–88% improvements in key flows including AD provisioning, SSO login, and integration group assignments

item.title: Improvements to Slack integration
item.description:
Improved Slack integration & reauthorization • Introduced modern OAuth reauthorization for Slack Enterprise Grid • Enables org-level reconnection with the correct permissions for user lifecycle events • Resolves issues with reactivation scenarios such as start date changes, rehires, and post-deactivation access
Enhanced Slack SSO setup experience • Dynamic setup instructions tailored to the customer’s Slack plan (Enterprise Grid vs Pro/Business+) • Step-by-step guidance for configuring SAML, navigating Slack settings, and testing setup • Replaces outdated one-size-fits-all instructions to reduce confusion and setup errors

item.title: Automating permission updates for Third-party Apps
item.description: Improved App Shop permissions management • Eliminated the need for one-off permission configuration for non-super admins • Enable permission profiles to automatically grant install access for new integrations • Streamlines access control for all newly published third-party App Shop integrations

item.title: Faster Software Installation Initiation
item.description: Faster software deployment • Significantly improved deployment speed across devices • New deployments now initiate within ~2 minutes of a device coming online

item.title: Revamped Device Enrollment Flow
item.description: Improved device onboarding experience • Streamlined the “add a device” flow for faster setup • Simplified trial account landing pages for a more intuitive experience • Makes it easier to get new devices up and running quickly on Rippling MDM

item.title: RPass Extension Popout
item.description: Enhanced RPass usability • Open RPass in a dedicated browser window for a more flexible experience • Enables persistent browsing while viewing and copying credentials

item.title: RPass Dark mode
item.description: RPass extension enhancements • Added dark mode support for a more comfortable viewing experience

item.title: Granular user account management during device assignment
item.description: Granular device assignment controls • Choose what user accounts to keep • Choose what user accounts to delete • Choose whether or not to create a new account • Edit both the username and full name for the account • Pick a local user account that will become the network account (for Windows devices with network accounts enabled)

item.title: Smooth migration for Windows (non-Entra)
item.description: Simplified device migration to Rippling MDM • Quickly migrate devices with minimal steps for a seamless transition • Supports migration from existing Windows MDM solutions • Applies to devices not joined to Microsoft Entra • Makes it easier for customers to transition to Rippling MDM
